posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked:
Five heroes (The Wraith, Absolute Zero, Visionary, Expatriette, Bunker) against Advanced Omnitron.

First villain card was an Electro-Pulse Explosive. The other Electro-Pulse Explosive came out in the second round.

We made a valiant attempt and it was one of the best uses of the Telekinetic Cocoon that I’ve seen (Visionary had more HP than the rest of the heroes combined), but our heroes went down and went down fast.

posts.name: Riffian
posts.cooked: Ouch. We played against Omnitron for the first time the other night and I hadn’t looked through the deck at all, so my eyes bulged a bit when he played an EPE. Luckily one of us had a card (I forget which) that could stall it for a round, Ra and Wraith were dealing decent amounts of damage by that point (and we weren’t playing advanced mode either), so we took it down. He also pulled two disintegration beams in a row before we disabled it. Thank goodness for Visionary and her ‘destroy ongoing’ power card.
